# Parse the note content to extract songs that need release months
import re
lines = note['content'].split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        m = re.match(r'- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO', line)
        if m:
            title = m.group(1).strip()
            artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            todo_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'line': line})
print(f"Found {len(todo_songs)} songs to update")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s['title'], '|', s['artists'])
